questions.question: Why did the Marmot sync command stop polling the server, and what replaced the polling?
gold_facts: Polling every 30 seconds used up the free-tier API quota
A websocket push channel replaced the polling

questions.question: Which delimiter does the Marmot CSV export use by default, and what was the reason for choosing it?
gold_facts: The default delimiter is a semicolon
Comma-decimal locales would otherwise break spreadsheet imports

questions.question: How does Marmot migrate an old config file, and what happens to the old file afterwards?
gold_facts: On first start it converts the old INI file to config.toml
The old file is renamed with a .bak suffix, not deleted
The migration is skipped when config.toml already exists
